name: antialias
what: rebuilds jagged, stair-stepped lines left by an earlier bad deinterlace or line-doubling: each field is re-interpolated with an edge-directed interpolator (nnedi3) and the two results are averaged
when: diagonal lines and curves show regular steps, or every second line repeats the one above it
softens: fine vertical detail everywhere (every line is re-interpolated); it cannot bring back the detail the bad deinterlace threw away
tried_on: none of the owner samples has this defect, so it was created artificially on an owner cartoon cut: one field kept and line-doubled: identical line pairs 0.00 -> 0.92 on a measure where the clean cut reads 0.95, guard passed. QTGMC's repair modes left most of the pairing (0.25). The error against the clean cut did not fall (0.78 -> 0.85): the lines are smooth again, the lost detail is not back. Not yet tried on a real source
